title: Column developer section
description: Developer pitch on a faint dot grid: a blue mono eyebrow with a blinking cursor, a hairline, a 28px navy heading, a muted lead, a white button and two short feature notes side by side. On the right a grey framed panel holds a white card slot over a numbered, syntax-coloured API response that runs off the bottom edge. The panel rises 200px and fades in as it scrolls into view.
notes: media fills the white card slot at the top of the panel; empty, it stays a plain white card
the panel reveal is a CSS view timeline; without support or with reduced motion it simply shows
